races.note: Sep 9 primary: D Foulkes 62.5% ousted incumbent McKee 37.5%; R Guckian 50.6% vs Elaine Pelino 49.4% (259 votes per Wikipedia, 271 unofficial). Pelino got a machine-data recount approved Sep 14; outcome not found in any source reached, and the Wikipedia infobox still says TBD, though Green Papers lists Guckian as nominee. Independents conflict: Wikipedia lists only Block; Green Papers and Politics1 also list Gotra and Reynolds. Ballotpedia page stale.
